title: form in modal lifecycle
rule: Form-in-Modal lifecycle — list-page "create" may popup a form in Modal. `destroyOnHidden` does not clear Form fields — call `resetFields`. `useForm` before open is disconnected unless `forceRender` (or equivalent). Prefer native submit; if the submit control is outside the Form (Modal footer), call `form.submit`.

citation.source: Ant Design — Form ; Ant Design — Modal

pass_when: Reopened create-modal form is reset (`resetFields`); form instance is connected when opened; footer submit still submits the Form (`form.submit` if outside).
fail_when: Stale fields after close (`destroyOnHidden` treated as reset); disconnected `useForm` without force-render; footer button that does not submit the Form.
overview: Create-modals reset fields, keep the form connected, and submit from the footer.
apply_when: Ant list-page create flows that open a form inside a Modal.
not_when: Inline page forms that are not mounted in a create Modal lifecycle.
agent_hint: Call resetFields on reopen; connect useForm; submit via form.submit from footer.
description: List-page create may open a form in a Modal. destroyOnHidden does not clear Form fields—call resetFields. useForm created before open stays disconnected unless forceRender (or equivalent) connects it. Prefer native submit; if the submit control sits in the Modal footer outside the Form, call form.submit. Stale fields, disconnected instances, or footer buttons that never submit break the lifecycle.
do_not_claim: API-table props beyond these named lifecycle facts; Polar "don't use modals for complex forms" as a winner.
